Name: Harvey Sprite for Seasonal Outfits Mod - Less Cute Version
Author: JustYourAverageWeirdo
Description:
I adore the Seasonal Outfits mod, but the overhaul of Harvey's sprite design was a bit much for me, because I honestly thought his sprite looked hot except for the leg-gap and his side-profile. The mod's version was too... cute. Chibi-fied? It just wasn't quite doing it for me, so I decided to alter the mod art to bring it a bit more in-line with the vanilla version, though not entirely (also, I gave him booty-shorts for his swim suit instead of a speedo, lol).

**DISCLAIMER**
I do not own this art. For all of the images, I simply tweaked Harvey's sprites in Paint.NET. As per Poltergeister's "Permissions" section in the original mod, I am allowed to edit and use the art as long as I give credit--so this is me giving credit ;)

I probably won't ever update this mod because it's just a little add-in I did for myself but decided to share for those who would also enjoy a tweaked version of Harvey's sprites. This is also only my second-ever mod I'm sharing, so thank you for being understanding <3


TO INSTALL:
﻿- Download Seasonal Outfits and all it's requirements
﻿- Download and Unzip my mod
﻿- Locate the correct folder in your mods folder (>Stardew Valley -> Mods -> [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters -> assets -> Characters -> Harvey)
﻿ ﻿(NOTE: my mod does nothing for the [-> assets -> Portraits-> Harvey] folder. That folder is for portraits only. My mod is specifically for his sprites)
﻿- Replace the Harvey folder with my mod folder (make sure the name is just "Harvey")
﻿- Enjoy!
